boundary_roles: Existing whole game/engine collision owners; no CRT/library/EH/helper recovery assignments or independent shared-tail counts.

findings.original: 004124d0 calls event2 then retains entity acceleration/spin fields through finish. 0041d7c0 case2 subtracts normal impulse scaled by friction*900, applies contact torque scaled by mass*270/2, and damps spin by.85.
findings.source_before: Player query modified entity+60/+6c/+54; separate BHPhysicsState was republished over those writes. Before-fix force/spin assertions confirm the loss; a third assertion incorrectly assumed a nonzero torque for its centered mesh contact and was replaced with an explicit off-center packet.
findings.source_after: Player constructor binds query.contact_physics. The actual event2 owner mirrors common entity state to that component before the enclosing physics finish; startup verifies the binding.
findings.validation: Actual decoded collision/sweep/contact chain with actual installed player query; bounce force and .85*.98 spin damping survive; controlled off-center event verifies angular-force transfer. A final negative control deliberately omits contact_physics and verifies the same real collision loses its bounce force and spin damping.

findings.original: 00412788 reads selected entity+8;0041278d JZ skips last-clear recovery for kind0 physical actors. Nonzero world/prop kind uses model+f8 and matrices+150/+180 for overlap retest.
findings.source_before: Last-clear recovery was gated on BH_WORLD_HIT_ACTOR instead of BH_WORLD_HIT_GEOMETRY.
findings.source_after: Recovery applies to world/prop geometry only. World penetration restores last-clear without RNG/effects; actor overlap follows ordinary contact path, emitting callbacks only for nonzero impulses.
findings.validation: Distinct real mesh fixtures for an embedded world collision and an embedded physical-actor collision.

compared_contracts: Integrate acceleration/spin over dt, reset force accumulators, then perform broad/narrow collision detection.
Original endpoint mesh tests, three bisections and optional origin-segment fallback retained; no replacement continuous solver introduced.
Tangential slide uses (movement-normal*dot)*(friction*(1-first_fraction)); second sweep disables segment fallback.
Normal push30+contact_speed*.00125 and signed impulse partition by masses retained; negative mass world objects do not receive a moving-body impulse.
Moving world geometry subtracts per-tick translation and retains original1.5 contact-motion scaling.
Final linear velocity is accepted displacement/dt*.995; angular damping.98 follows callback damping.85; original gravity sign retained.
Ordinary contacts and special surface flags2/4/8 retain separate response arithmetic; original PC24 rounding behavior remains unresolved.
limits: Static original comparison and source-only fixtures; no original or source gameplay execution.
This is a selected collision/bounce audit, not proof of every collision mesh, portal, contact normal or extreme-speed case.
Human tunnel-wall and prop comparisons remain pending; no software-renderer tests.
